# Deepak Prasad - Senior Product Manager Portfolio

> Deepak Prasad is a Senior Product Manager with 7+ years of experience across India and Europe, specializing in 0→1 products, AI systems, B2B marketplaces, and consumer SaaS. Former Lead PM at ReshaMandi (scaled to $50M+ GMV, 80K+ farmers, 99.9% automated payouts) and Product Lead at fitpage (scaled AI endurance coach 10x DAU, built subscription engine from 0 to 12K+ paying subscribers).

## Core Case Studies

- [ReshaMandi B2B Agri-Fintech Ecosystem](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/reshamandi): Re-architecting India's silk supply chain with an instant farmer payout engine (< 2 hours from 15 days), CV cocoon grading, and live auction bidding across 80K+ farmers.
- [AI Endurance Coach](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/ai-coach): 0→1 multimodal training intelligence powering personalized marathon coaching, scaling from 300 to 3,200+ DAU with 48% higher week-4 retention.
- [B2C SaaS Subscription Engine](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/subscription-engine): Built recurring monetization architecture from zero to 12K+ paid subscribers, cutting checkout drop-off by 38%.
- [Holistic Performance Score](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/performance-score): Multi-device physiological fitness scoring engine normalizing metrics across 5 wearable ecosystems without hardware lock-in.
- [AI Global Content Localization Platform](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/ai-localization): Human-in-the-loop automated translation and cultural adaptation pipeline reducing turnaround by 65%.

## Operating Principles

1. Ground Truth First: Spend time where the product is actually used — in warehouses, on tracks, and with real end users.
2. Zero Friction by Design: Eliminate needless intermediate steps; high velocity comes from unblocking transactions and user intent.
3. MVP First, Iterate Relentlessly: Ship working software quickly to validate core value propositions before scaling architecture.
4. Go-To-Market from Day 0: Build product and distribution in tandem, partnering closely with sales, marketing, and operations.
5. Find High-Leverage Points: Identify the 20% of product surface that creates 80% of business and user impact.
6. Shared Ownership: High-trust team culture with clear context, continuous feedback, and transparent decision-making.
